title: Bugs/remove asm inv mfg clean27 tags for wave2 2026
summary: Removes the obsolete code that was kept under CLEAN27 conditional compilation in assembly, inventory, manufacturing and planning objects of the Base Application, its localization layers, and the Subcontracting, Sustainability and CZ Advanced Localization Pack apps.
key_points: Deletes code previously marked obsolete and guarded by CLEAN27 tags
Affects Base Application objects in W1 and several localization layers such as APAC, CH, DACH, ES, FI, GB, IT, NA and RU
Also cleans up Subcontracting, Sustainability and CZ Advanced Localization Pack subscribers
Extensions still using the removed obsolete members must be updated
